limitations_and_boundaries: The difference in tumor volume between lapatinib-only and lapatinib plus YAP knockdown groups was not statistically significant.
HER3 compensatory activation was not observed at the conditions used (1.5 μM lapatinib, 48 h), but may occur at lower doses or longer times.
In vivo studies require more comprehensive animal studies to clarify independent versus synergistic effects.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

research_questions.statement: Does matrix rigidity modulate the sensitive versus resistant states in HER2-amplified breast cancer cell responses to the HER2-targeted kinase inhibitor lapatinib?

provenance.text_excerpt: Thus HCC1569 cells responded to lapatinib in an elastic modulus–dependent manner, showing greater resistance to the antiproliferative effect of lapatinib on rigid matrices.

claims.statement: Substrate elastic modulus modifies lapatinib responses in HER2-amplified breast cancer cells; greater rigidity increases resistance.

experiments_or_tasks: Dose-response curves for lapatinib on 400-Pa PA gel vs. 2D TCP were generated to calculate IC50.
HCC1569 cells were cultured on 2D TCP or 400-Pa PA gels and treated with 1.5 μM lapatinib or DMSO for 48 h; EdU incorporation was measured.
HCC1569 cells were cultured on 2D TCP or in 3D Matrigel and treated with 1.5 μM lapatinib or DMSO for 48 h; EdU incorporation was measured.

methods.name: Cell culture and drug treatment
methods.protocol_description: HCC1569 and BT549 cells were maintained in RPMI 1640 with 10% FBS and 1% penicillin/streptomycin/glutamine. For 2D cultures, cells were plated in 24-well plates with RPMI 1640 with 1% FBS and 1% penicillin/streptomycin/glutamine for 48 h after adhesion, then treated with 1.5 μM lapatinib or DMSO for 48 h. For 3D cultures, cells were cultured on Matrigel-coated plates using the 'on-top' protocol with 5% Matrigel, and drugs were added on day 4 for 48 h. For PA gel experiments, cells were cultured on 400-Pa PA gels coated with type 1 collagen.

methods.name: In vivo xenograft model
methods.protocol_description: HCC1569 cells with IPTG-inducible YAP shRNA were implanted in mice. Mice were treated with IPTG, lapatinib, both, or neither. Tumor volume was measured over 23 days.

study_units.name: YAP knockdown in vivo increases sensitivity to lapatinib

provenance.text_excerpt: Mice that received neither IPTG nor lapatinib (group A) had the maximum tumor volume (mean of volume, 1280 mm3) by day 23. Mice treated with IPTG (group B) had significantly decreased (p < 0.05) tumor volume (mean of volume, 770 mm3) compared with group A. Lapatinib treatment groups either with (group D) or without IPTG treatment (group C) had much smaller tumor volumes compared with groups A and B. Group D, which received lapatinib and had reduced YAP levels, had the smallest tumor volumes (mean of volume, 192 mm3), even compared with group C (mean of volume, 269 mm3); however, that difference was not statistically significant.
